  alias CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.DiscountedLineTotal, as: DLT

    items = record.items
    coupon_code = Map.get(opts, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(opts, :as_of)

    {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, coupon, as_of, subtotal)

    discounted_subtotal = subtotal - discount
    tax_cents = compute_tax(discounted_subtotal, record.region)
    total_cents = discounted_subtotal + tax_cents

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross_subtotal,
      tier_discount_cents: gross_subtotal - subtotal,
      subtotal_cents: subtotal,
      coupon_status: status,
      coupon_discount_cents: discount,

      tax_cents: tax_cents,
      total_cents: total_cents,
      item_count: item_count
    }

      DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
      coupon.max_redemptions != nil && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions ->
        {:exhausted, 0}
      subtotal < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
      true ->
        discount = floor(subtotal * coupon.percent_off_bps / 10_000)
        final_discount = if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(discount, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: discount
        {:applied, final_discount}
    end
  end

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  def calculate(record, opts, _context) do
    {:ok, do_calculate(record, opts)}
  end

  def batch(records, opts, _context) do
    {:ok, Enum.map(records, &do_calculate(&1, opts))}
  end

  defp do_calculate(record, opts) do
    items = if is_list(record), do: hd(record).items, else: record.items
    opts = Map.new(opts)
    coupon_code = Map.get(opts, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(opts, :as_of)

    # Raw computations independent of calculated attributes
    item_stats = Enum.map(items, fn item ->
      line_total = item.unit_price_cents * item.quantity
      tier_bps = cond do
        item.quantity < 5 -> 0
        item.quantity < 10 -> 500
        item.quantity < 25 -> 1000
        true -> 1500
      end
      discount = floor(line_total * tier_bps / 10_000)
      discounted = line_total - discount
      {line_total, discounted}
    end)

    gross_subtotal = Enum.sum(Enum.map(item_stats, &elem(&1, 0)))
    subtotal = Enum.sum(Enum.map(item_stats, &elem(&1, 1)))
    item_count = Enum.count(items)

    coupon = if coupon_code, do: CartPricing.Sales.get_coupon_by_code(coupon_code)
    {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, coupon, as_of, subtotal)

    discounted_subtotal = subtotal - discount
    tax_cents = compute_tax(discounted_subtotal, if(is_list(record), do: hd(record).region, else: record.region))
    total_cents = discounted_subtotal + tax_cents

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross_subtotal,
      tier_discount_cents: gross_subtotal - subtotal,
      subtotal_cents: subtotal,
      coupon_status: status,
      coupon_discount_cents: discount,
      discounted_subtotal_cents: discounted_subtotal,
      tax_cents: tax_cents,
      total_cents: total_cents,
      item_count: item_count
    }
  end

  def load(_, _, _) do
    [:region, :items, items: [:unit_price_cents, :quantity]]
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _as_of, _subtotal), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(_code, nil, _as_of, _subtotal), do: {:not_found, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(_code, coupon, as_of, subtotal) do
    cond do
      DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
      DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
      coupon.max_redemptions != nil && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions ->

      subtotal < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
      true ->
